label: What is your current MAICPP tier?
help: This establishes your starting point on the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program continuum.

label: Do you have an active Solutions Partner designation?
help: Solutions Partner designations are the main bridge into specializations and Frontier readiness.

label: How many individuals hold Microsoft intermediate certifications?
help: Use unique individuals, not duplicated certificate counts.

label: How many individuals hold advanced role-based certifications?
help: Examples include SC-200, MS-700, AZ-305, AZ-500, and similar role-based credentials.

label: How many active customers do you have with Microsoft 365 licenses?
help: A directional indicator of Modern Work reach and expansion potential.

label: How many active customers do you have with Azure consumption?
help: Azure customer count helps estimate performance and deployment readiness.

label: In the last 12 months, how many new customers have you added with at least $500 per month Azure spend?
help: This approximates the SMB path performance category for net customer adds.

label: What is your approximate total Azure Consumed Revenue per month?
help: A range is enough. This helps calibrate SMB versus enterprise path recommendations.

label: Has your total Azure Consumed Revenue grown in the last 12 months?
help: Use the closest range if you do not have an exact number.

label: Have you deployed any of these solutions in the last 12 months?
help: Select documented or documentable deployments tied to customer work.

label: Do you have documented customer success stories or case studies?
help: Customer proof is critical for specialization and Frontier readiness.

label: Are you enrolled in Microsoft Commerce Incentives?
help: MCI enrollment helps confirm incentive readiness after designation.

label: Which solution area is your primary business focus?
help: The roadmap will prioritize certification and deployment actions around this area.

label: What is your number one goal for the next 12 months?
help: This lets the tool tune the recommendations to what you are trying to accomplish.

label: Do you have a TD SYNNEX Business Development Manager assigned to you?
help: This determines whether the export recommends a direct handoff or a routing request.
